_comment_method: The training method the control plane selected at provisioning (issue #66): 'qlora' or 'full'. The trainer builds the matching config (adapter vs no adapter) and collects the matching artifact (adapter pair vs whole-model archive). A spec without it reads as qlora, the only method that ever ran before the key existed. A 'full' spec arrives with the method-resolved hyperparameters (its own learning rate).
_comment_hyperparameters: The COMPLETE resolved set. The control plane resolves every hyperparameter before launch (issue #83): defaults, alpha recomputed from rank when rank moves alone, rsLoRA inferred at rank >= 32, and -- for a 'full' method spec -- the method's own values (its lower learning rate, issue #66). This trainer resolves nothing -- it applies exactly what it is given. A standalone job must supply every required key itself; a missing key fails with error_code spec_incomplete naming the keys, never a silent fallback. An unknown key is echoed back in result.json under rejected_overrides and not applied.
_comment_max_steps: Optional. Overrides num_epochs; used by smoke tests to keep a run to a handful of steps.
_comment_resume: Set to a checkpoint path under /out/run to resume. The orchestrator sets this on retry after a preemption or crash.
_comment_artifact_upload: Optional (ADR-0009). When the control plane supplies a scoped write URL, the machine PUTs its artifact directly to it and records the outcome in result.json under artifact_upload. A standalone run carries no grant and simply leaves the artifact on /out. The URL is minted for exactly one key and expires with the job; the machine holds no credential that outlives it.
_comment_checkpoint_grants: Optional (issue #37). When the control plane supplies scoped write URLs, one per retention slot, the machine PUTs each completed checkpoint to its slot as it is produced and records step, loss, slot, checksum and outcome in result.json under checkpoints. A standalone run carries no grants and leaves its checkpoints on /out. Each URL is minted for exactly one checkpoints/... key and expires with the job.
